scheme_name: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Specially Abled Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Union Territory of Lakshadweep
Applicant must be a specially‑abled person (deaf, dumb, blind, mentally retarded, or orthopedically disabled) with at least 40% disability certified by a competent authority
Applicant must have no source of income and monthly income must not exceed ₹1,500
Applicant must not be a recipient of any other similar pension scheme provided by the government
benefits_summary: Eligible individuals receive a monthly pension of ₹1,500 (₹18,000 per annum) transferred directly to their bank account
